_comment: Every external source CityPulse evaluated. Only sources with ingestion="active" are fetched. Status reflects what was verified on 2026-10-16.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (via Overpass API)
sources.access_method: Overpass QL over HTTPS (public instance, fair-use)
sources.license: ODbL 1.0 — © OpenStreetMap contributors; attribution required, share-alike on derived databases
sources.reliability: Community-mapped; good coverage of named places and major amenities in Delhi, not authoritative for jurisdiction
sources.limitations: Operator tags are community claims, not official responsibility records. Place nodes are points, not polygons.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap Nominatim (reverse geocoding)
data_types: nearest named road for a submitted report/venue
sources.access_method: HTTPS, max 1 request/second, identifying User-Agent, no bulk geocoding
sources.refresh: on demand (one call per new report or venue)
sources.reliability: Good for major roads; may return a nearby POI instead of the road
sources.limitations: Heavy use requires a self-hosted instance

sources.name: NDMA SACHET — CAP Integrated Alert System
data_types: official disaster/weather alerts (IMD, SDMAs) in Common Alerting Protocol
sources.access_method: Public RSS feed + per-alert CAP XML (FetchXMLFile). Alert polygon endpoint returns HTTP 403 to automated clients, so it is NOT used.
sources.coverage: All India; CityPulse keeps alerts whose sender, author or area mention Delhi
sources.reliability: Official alert dissemination system of the National Disaster Management Authority
sources.limitations: Area matching uses the CAP areaDesc text against OSM district/neighbourhood names; without polygons, a district-level alert affects all neighbourhoods OSM places inside that district.

sources.name: Mapbox (map tiles, address search)
sources.access_method: Mapbox GL JS + Search API with a project token
sources.license: Mapbox Terms of Service. Temporary geocoding results are displayed, not stored as city data; the stored resident location is the point the resident confirms on the map.
sources.limitations: Requires NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN. Production should use Mapbox permanent geocoding if geocoder output is persisted.

sources.name: Delhi Traffic Police advisories
sources.access_method: No public API or feed found; advisories are published as web posts and on social media
sources.limitations: Not ingested: no documented machine-readable access and no stated reuse permission. Not scraped.

sources.name: Delhi Tourism / Ministry of Tourism event listings
sources.access_method: HTML pages only; no API/feed found
sources.limitations: Not ingested. Events in CityPulse are genuine resident/organizer submissions, labelled as such.

sources.name: Open Government Data Platform India (data.gov.in)
sources.access_method: REST API with personal API key
sources.reliability: Official, but many Delhi datasets are stale snapshots
sources.limitations: Evaluated; not ingested in the hackathon window (requires API key and dataset-by-dataset validation).

sources.name: CityPulse community submissions
sources.access_method: Submitted through the CityPulse app by residents with a quick profile
sources.license: Submitted by residents for publication on CityPulse
sources.reliability: Community-reported; corroboration tracked in the graph
sources.limitations: Not verified by any government authority.
